response.sql: WITH cat AS (SELECT category, AVG(remaining) AS avg_remaining, SUM(amount - spent) AS total FROM budget WHERE amount > 75 GROUP BY category), overall AS (SELECT AVG(total) AS avg_total FROM cat) SELECT c.category, c.avg_remaining, c.total, c.total - o.avg_total AS diff_above_avg FROM cat c CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE o.avg_total IS NOT NULL AND c.total > o.avg_total
